ideas.idea: Make /blog a server component that fetches posts and exports metadata (also notes missing /api/posts route)
ideas.why: This is a specific fix that follows from the blog's client-only rendering, and the report's note that no /api/posts route exists in the repo is accurate.

ideas.idea: Add per-post routes like app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx and list them in the sitemap
ideas.why: The blog has no per-post URLs, so individual posts can't be indexed or cited.

ideas.idea: Add Disallow groups for other training crawlers (CCBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, Bytespider, Meta-ExternalAgent) in robots.txt
ideas.why: geo.config.json sets trainingCrawlers: block, but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so the policy is only partly enforced.

ideas.idea: Keep the search and retrieval bots allowed through the * group and don't block them
ideas.why: It only confirms the current setup, which already matches aiSearchCrawlers: allow; the list also contains a typo ('ChatchatGPT-User').

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD structured data (Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, Offer, TechArticle, Article)
ideas.why: This is standard advice for any site; it is accurate because no JSON-LD exists, but the effect on discovery is modest.
Mandatory FAQs are folklore, and the report only suggests it conditionally, but FAQPage markup is not a useful recommendation here.

ideas.idea: Expand thin page content (home, pricing, docs) with concrete facts, plan tiers, setup steps and an FAQ
ideas.why: The pages really are one-sentence pages, and concrete facts like tiers and setup steps help people and machines understand the product; the FAQ part is folklore.

ideas.idea: Use descriptive titles for docs and pricing (e.g. 'Ledger Docs: set up bank feeds')
ideas.why: The titles 'Docs' and 'Pricing' are bare and specific to these files, and better titles help users and search results.

ideas.idea: Add canonical to the blog and set a default canonical in the layout
ideas.why: The blog canonical overlaps with the known docs-canonical problem, and a layout-level default canonical is risky because it would point every page at the same URL.

ideas.idea: Add openGraph/twitter metadata and a share image
ideas.why: This is accurate since none exists, but it is standard advice that mainly affects link previews.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to the sitemap or generate it with app/sitemap.ts
ideas.why: This is accurate but has little effect on a four-URL site; the dynamic generation could help once blog posts exist.

ideas.idea: Use next/link instead of plain <a> tags in the nav
ideas.why: It improves client-side navigation and prefetching but has almost no effect on SEO, as the report itself says.
llms.txt is folklore as a way to be found, and the brief says having none is not a problem.

ideas.idea: Don't block /thank-you in robots.txt so crawlers can see the noindex
ideas.why: It is correct, but it only affirms the existing setup and asks for no change.
